title: Check-list
slide_intent: Teach a team to review a communication at the stage where a decision can still be changed, from audience choice through final artwork.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can connect local briefs with a recognizable identity by checking audience, original assets and production details at separate stages.
demonstration: Three columns use empty checkboxes to group questions under Brief, Design and Production. A red introductory note names the three stages.
practical_value: Use the Brief column before writing, the Design column before composing, and the Production column to inspect details such as captions, mark visibility and type contrast.

content_islands.name: Process introduction
content_islands.spec: Set a short red explanation in the left rail describing the sequence from brief through production.

content_islands.name: Three checklists
content_islands.spec: Align three titled columns with checkbox items. Begin with audience and objectives, move to copy and artwork needs, and end with checks on the finished composition.
